description:
Decide from the prototypes how users choose between a portable build and an architecture build.

To settle: the default; where the choice is written (config, use Defk option, env var, per kernel) and its exact spelling; named levels vs native; what happens on a CPU mismatch (error vs fallback); whether one release may carry several variants; cache key/.so naming; what DEFK_RESULT reports; interaction with defk-n8f and the C-compiler stance. Write it as a short decision record with the evidence and rejected options.

Done when the decision is recorded (docs/research/simd.md or a decision doc) and implementation tickets are filed.
title: Decide: the target build API (portable vs architecture) and its deploy story
